description: Slovakia RPO register (Statistical Office open API): looks up a legal entity by its 8-digit company ID (IČO) and returns registered names, establishment date, registry court and address. Search by name is not supported by the API; open data under CC BY 4.0. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
